name: Tianlong
subtitle: Heavenly Dragon
lore: For ages, the Heavenly Dragon guarded the dwellings of the gods, and people believed spotting it in the night sky meant good fortune. Since the merging of divine and mortal realms, Tianlong’s charge now includes guarding Tian as a whole. The dragon’s strength is stretched thin, potentially leaving the gods’ homes vulnerable to dangers they previously were not.
divinity_generator: Gain [30] Divinity when hit by an enemy.

awakening_bonuses.bonus: Awaken the ability: Mandate of Heaven
Shield Multiplier +30%, DMG Reduction Multiplier +20%, C.DMG Reduction Multiplier +20%
Attunement Multiplier +50%, Armor Multiplier +30%, Weapon Multiplier +30%

skills.name: Aerial Aegis
skills.description: Place [mechanic:immortal] on this hero for 2 turns, then place [mechanic:intercept] on all allies except this hero for 2 turns. If an ally already has [mechanic:intercept], increase the duration by 1 turn instead.
skills.awakening_bonus: While under [Immortal], damage received from [Intercept] cannot exceed 15% of this hero’s MAX HP.

skills.name: Dragon's Edict
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy (300%DEF+130%ATK) with a 50% chance to place [mechanic:atk-down-ii] on the target for 2 turns.

skills.name: Mandate of Heaven
skills.description: Remove all [Debuff] from all allies, and attack all enemies (320%DEF+160%ATK). Also increase the DEF of all allies by 10% (stacking up to 3 times), and increase the duration of [mechanic:intercept] on all allies by 1 turn.
skills.awakening_bonus: Also resets the cooldown of Aerial Aegis.

skills.name: Skybound Ward
skills.description: When damaged by [mechanic:intercept], [Heal]100%DEF the attacked ally and place [mechanic:barrier]50%DEF on them.
skills.awakening_bonus: This ability is still under review - please check back later.

imprint_passive: When this hero [Intercepts] an attack, Heal 100%DEF the attacked ally and place [Barrier]50%DEF on them.
